title: Sandustry Water Basics — Wet Sand, Fluids & Pipes
description: High-level Sandustry water and fluid tips: wet sand, flooding digs, and why pipes matter in Early Access.

paragraphs: Steam and community chatter both treat fluids as part of the fantasy — wet sand, pumps, and pipes sit next to conveyors in the automation story.
Digging without watching moisture can bury machines or starve refining loops that expect wet material.
Watch the dig face for unexpected floods before placing fragile logistics.
Keep a dry buffer zone around key refiners if water is migrating.
Learn one pump and pipe path before branching a full fluid network.
When stuck, pause digging and fix fluid routing — more sand rarely fixes a flooded belt.
Exact fluid rules, heat interactions, and building unlocks change in EA.
Cross-check the official Hooded Horse Sandustry wiki and current patch notes for recipes and building names.

faq.a: Steam's marketing highlights refining wet sand toward gold. Treat that as the intended early fantasy, and confirm steps in your current build and the official wiki.
